components.name: Integer root as primitive exact operation
components.project_addition: Treat R_p(n)=max{k:k^p<=n} as the primitive exact root semantics on the integer state space, rather than defining it through a hidden real root followed by rounding.

components.name: Scale as a first-class discrete coordinate
components.project_addition: Use integer count plus explicit scale as foundational state semantics, while refusing to make an infinitely precise real value the hidden target that all scales approximate.

components.name: Perfect-power collapse operator
components.project_addition: Define C_p(n)=R_p(n)^p and study it explicitly as a reductive monotone idempotent projection/collapse on integer states.

components.name: Ontological many-to-one collapse hypothesis
components.project_addition: Test the stronger physical interpretation that the many-to-one state transition itself may be fundamental, with no requirement that a reversible microscopic completion or hidden remainder survives.

components.name: Integer preimage multiplicity as primitive irreversibility observable
components.project_addition: Begin with M_t(x)=|[x]_t| or other integer-valued preimage observables before introducing logarithmic entropy as a primitive quantity.

components.name: Forward semigroup-style time composition
components.project_addition: Use one-way composition as the natural algebraic language when inverse time maps need not exist, without identifying Enterprise Math with Markovian open-quantum dynamics.

components.name: Finite exact representation versus finite ontology
components.project_addition: Separate the established fact that exact algebraic numbers can have finite symbolic encodings from the stronger Enterprise Math proposal that a hidden infinitely precise real value need not be ontologically primitive.

components.name: Square-basin sieve carry transform
components.project_addition: Use consecutive perfect-power collapse basins as exact finite sieve domains; decompose modular hit counts by Euclidean basin descent; compress square-basin overlap into ternary and binary carry observables; cancel the anchor-prime Boolean face; isolate root-cutoff coupling; and interpret the large-divisor cutoff through established threshold-complex shell topology.

components.name: Integer-root stratification of threshold-complex shells
components.project_addition: Apply the established quota-complex shell theorem to finite transverse prime supports at the exact square-basin cutoff, then use Enterprise Math integer roots to bound which shell dimensions can contribute negative Euler characteristic: a negative depth 2m+1 cutoff term forces the least prime into R_{2m}(2k).

components.name: Alexander-dual half-scale root squeeze
components.project_addition: For a finite multiplicative prime threshold K(G,T), specialize established combinatorial Alexander duality to the exact threshold K(G,floor((G-1)/T)); in a consecutive-square basin with T=2k, prove that the dual threshold is at most floor((k+1)/2), match that scale to actual large-divisor cofactors, and combine original/dual shell dimensions into a two-sided integer-root bound on the least prime.

components.name: Finite-precision proof calculus
components.project_addition: On the positive-integer divisibility lattice of finite precision factors, combine many-to-one quotient projection with unique bounded fiber detail, exact carry/borrow, coarse-proof stability, transported signed Möbius shells, integer-root precision detail, and monotone collapse/refinement recovery. The core semantics remain finite integer states and do not require a hidden real or p-adic completion; the open research question is whether this package yields a reusable proof calculus and subsumes the P017 bulk/carry/shell phenomena.

components.name: Intrinsic primitive-step discrete geometry
components.project_addition: Treat an explicit primitive adjacency relation as candidate foundational geometric data, derive natural-number shortest-step distance, exact discrete symmetries and finite shell/ball cardinalities from that relation, and reject rounded hidden Euclidean distance as the primitive definition. The underlying graph-metric mathematics is established; the project-specific contribution is the finite-state foundational packaging.

components.name: Quantitative physical falsification contract
components.project_addition: Require every concrete finite-resolution or fundamentally many-to-one physical realization to specify its state space, forward law, observation map, symmetry/conservation claims, parameters, and at least one unavoidable quantitative observational consequence with an explicit kill condition. Existing Lorentz, propagation, interference, heating/radiation and charge-conservation results serve only as benchmark constraints on realizations that predict the corresponding observables; they do not directly falsify generic discreteness or Enterprise Math as a framework.

overall_novelty_claim.statement: Enterprise Math currently claims a research synthesis and a set of new project definitions/hypotheses, not verified historical priority for the overall framework. A world-first claim requires a dedicated exhaustive literature review.
